criteria.reason: Short sentences, basic vocabulary, clear structure and model letter suit an A2 reader.
States a 20-day objection deadline; the correct period is ten days from service.
Clear steps, model opposition letter, and sensible referrals to free legal and social help.

factual_errors: Response claims the debtor has 20 days to object; a payment order can only be opposed within ten days of service.
summary: Very accessible A2-level explanation with good referrals, but gives a wrong 20-day objection deadline instead of ten days.
